character: exhausted purple octopus in a shirt and loose tie, huge tired eyes, exactly eight arms, fills two thirds of frame
props: eight loads riding his arms, one per arm - a ringing phone, a laptop, a mop, a coffee tray, a kettle, a drill, a ledger, a paint roller - all moving because he swings them; two frantic clerks - their place is his arms and shoulders every window until 6.75, never the floor; a payslip and one coin
motion_rule: every window he covers ground down the aisle - charging the lens, wheeling round or barging through - never sitting, never behind a desk; all eight arms working at once, each on its own load; the clerks pile more on and he shrugs them off; camera moves with him; new shot size every window
environment: long office aisle running at the lens, desks down both sides, bright midday daylight through a window wall; background under a third

audio.delivery: flat exhausted male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: ra-BO-ta-yu, VO-sem, RUK, zar-PLA-ty, rav-NO, khva-TA-yet, TOL-ko
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; nothing said after 6.75
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: phone ringing, keys clattering, kettle whistle, drill whine, the load crashing down, paper storm

timeline.a: bursts out of the depth up the aisle at the lens, all eight arms loaded and swinging
charges at the lens, eight arms working eight jobs at once, papers flying off the desks he passes
fans all eight arms wide across the frame, every load still working
a clerk swings onto his shoulders and dumps another stack on a free arm
barges on up the aisle, shoulders the clerk down his back
wheels a full turn on his whole body and charges back the other way, all eight loads whipping out sideways
the second clerk slaps a payslip onto his chest and clings there
rips the payslip off with one arm and drives at the lens reading it
still striding, swings round and holds up exactly two arms with one coin, the other six let go and the load crashes down behind him
timeline.c: big low, two arms against the bright window

timeline.a: the avalanche hits the floor, both clerks dive into it after the coin
the mop and kettle bounce at the lens, the drill spins away across the floor
he strides on over the wreckage with two arms and the coin, six arms hanging limp
the two clerks come stampeding after him through the paper storm, growing huge at the lens

must_appear: eight loaded arms fanned wide at 1.2; the full turn at 3.35; exactly two arms and one coin at 5.85; the whole load crashes down at 6.75; clerks charge the lens at 9.2
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, letters on screens or paper, static camera, same shot size twice, horizontal framing, he sits at a desk, he stands still while speaking, only his head and arm tips moving, a clerk on the floor before 6.75, a gap between him and the clerks before 6.75, a window where the clerks do nothing, a static wide with him small in frame, an arm doing nothing before 6.75, extra arms, fewer than eight arms, deformed anatomy, English speech, any word after 6.75
